nodes.label: Templates as separate files migration
nodes.rationale: Move project task templates out of YAML frontmatter (project.md taskTemplates) into individual .md files under шаблоны/{slug}/ per project, so taskTemplates never pollutes project frontmatter, each template is versionable/portable, and the old frontmatter field is stripped on next save via migration.

nodes.label: Auto status transitions (parent follows child, auto-complete at 100%)
nodes.rationale: Parent task status follows the farthest-along active child (highest config index); if all children are terminal the parent becomes completeStatusId; task auto-completes when progress reaches 100%. Status recalculation always runs, progress recalculation only in 'status' auto-progress mode.
nodes.norm_label: auto status transitions (parent follows child, auto-complete at 100%)

nodes.label: Await async loads before first render
nodes.rationale: TaskModal.onOpen called loadTemplates() without awaiting, so render() ran against an emptied taskTemplates array (loadTemplates sync-empties before its first await), hiding templates and letting an in-flight scan clobber a just-saved template. Fix: await loadTemplates in an init() before the first render(); render() is idempotent and disk refresh is preserved.
nodes.norm_label: await async loads before first render

nodes.label: Chained-setter component API
nodes.rationale: Primitives model a chained-setter API on Obsidian's ButtonComponent (constructor takes parentEl, root exposed as .el) and must import nothing from store/ or main. Extend an existing primitive with a new setter/variant instead of adding one-off elements; new primitives must update the styleguide and StyleguideView together.

nodes.label: UI layering: primitives / composites / orchestrators
nodes.rationale: Composites take resolved data + callbacks via props only - no plugin, no store, no onRefresh; if a composite needs plugin, store access must be pushed up to the orchestrator view. Layer rules (what each may import) live in CLAUDE.md under UI layers.

nodes.label: KanbanView.renderBoard
nodes.rationale: Config resolved once per board render via plugin.store.configFor; statuses drive column creation and status-aware card metadata.

nodes.label: KanbanView.hydrateDescriptions
nodes.rationale: Task descriptions live in the note body which loads lazily; loads bodies for matching cards then re-renders the board so previews fill in.

nodes.label: KanbanView.buildCardData
nodes.rationale: Derives per-card presentation data: priority color (only for critical/high), markdown-stripped description preview capped at 240 chars, parent title when showing subtasks, subtask progress, logged hours and overdue flag.

nodes.label: KanbanView.handleDrop
nodes.rationale: Verifies the dragged task matches the drop, then persists status via store.updateTask and refreshes.

nodes.label: renderDependencyArrows
nodes.rationale: Draws curved bezier arrows from each dependency's due (start of due+1) to the successor's start, with a reusable pm-arrowhead marker in <defs>.
